About

Hey! I’m Nina, the creator behind Gacha Satan. I’ve been part of the Gacha community since 2017, long before I started creating content myself.

In 2022, I started posting edits that eventually reached a much wider audience than I ever expected. What began as a hobby slowly turned into something much bigger, growing into a platform with over a million followers.

I’ve always enjoyed experimenting with editing, trying out new effects and finding different ways to bring characters and stories to life. It’s something I’ve continued developing over the years, and I’m still finding new ways to be creative.

I’m excited to see where this journey takes me and to explore new opportunities along the way.
